ModelMetadata.Description: Healthcare IoT Testbed - Users table and single-table Metadata table. Entities: DEVICE, ARTIFACT (all uploaded and produced files, incl. firmware; firmware versions unique per device via DEVICE#/FWVER# guard rows), BATCH (upload batches), MODULE (kind script|tool, runtime cloud|local) with VERSION#n, ENV (interactive/run images) with VERSION#n, RUN (cloud Batch executions) with CHILD#/RESULT#, SESSION (interactive JupyterLab only), per-user BUDGET and USAGE# ledger. Ownership is stored as two-way USER#/X# + X#/USER# links with role=owner only (a GROUP# principal can reuse the same shape later). Device links are optional. Deployed firmware Lambdas still write DEVICE#/FIRMWARE# rows until the ARTIFACT# migration runs. See Platform/infra/DATABASE.md.
